answer: Rule: one identity needs one proctored skill licence. Activation locks 45 units, then the candidate sits a unique timed exam set no other identity may reuse, verified live by a rotating proctor panel. Cheating or failure burns the 45 units. One operator sits only one exam per day, so one fake costs 45 units plus one day and ten fakes burn 450 units over ten days, linear in money and serial in time. A tide of copies cannot wander through when each pigment of reused work fails its unique set.
